passage:
A farmer found an old coin in a field and gave it to a museum. It was small, dark, and easy to miss.
Experts studied the coin and learned that traders had passed through the area long ago. The town, once thought to be unimportant in history, had been part of a wider network.
Students visited the museum and saw the coin under bright light.
One asked how such a tiny object could change what people knew.
The guide answered, "History often changes because of small evidence."
The coin had once bought something ordinary. Centuries later, it bought the town a new understanding of its past.

questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “A farmer found an old coin in a field and gave it to a museum.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Ancient Coin: A farmer found an old coin in a field and gave it to a museum.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Tiny Museum」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Ancient Toy」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Ancient Recipe」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
